papers.title: Digital Health Adoption, eHealth Literacy, and Trust in AI Among Generation Z University Students in Sri Lanka: An Empirical Study
papers.translated_title: 斯里兰卡Z世代大学生中的数字健康采纳、电子健康素养与对人工智能的信任：一项实证研究
papers.author: Athukorala, S. C.
papers.summary: Background: Digital health technologies, spanning mobile applications, telemedicine, and AI-driven platforms, are rapidly reshaping healthcare delivery globally. Although Generation Z university students are classified as digital natives, empirical data evaluating their eHealth literacy, technology acceptance, and specific trust barriers in developing South Asian nations like Sri Lanka remain scarce. Objective: This study evaluated eHealth literacy, technology acceptance, online health information-seeking behaviors, and adoption barriers among Gen Z undergraduates in Sri Lanka, focusing on the interplay between eHealth literacy, AI trust, and digital care preferences. Methods: A cross-sectional survey (N = 172) was conducted among Sri Lankan university undergraduates utilizing adapted, validated instruments: the eHealth Literacy Scale (eHEALS) and the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Statistical analysis included scale reliability validation (Cronbach's alpha), descriptive profiling, Chi-Square ({chi}{superscript 2}) contingency tests, Pearson correlations, and Multiple Linear OLS Regression models. Results: Participants demonstrated high overall eHealth literacy (Mean = 3.84 {+/-} 0.58) and strong endorsement of digital health utility (Mean = 3.99 {+/-} 0.59). Online health searches were reported by 86.6% of respondents. AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) emerged as the second most frequent source for health queries (57.6%), surpassing YouTube (44.2%) and social media (26.2%), with medical students showing significantly higher AI utilization ({chi}{superscript 2} = 8.70, p = .003). In multiple regression analysis, digital platform preference over physical clinic visits (R{superscript 2} = .352, p < .001) was significantly predicted by Perceived Ease of Use ({beta} = 0.371, p = .001) and Trust in AI Recommendations ({beta} = 0.370, p < .001), whereas face-to-face consultation preference (76.7%) and personal data privacy risks (50.0%) remained predominant adoption barriers. Conclusion: Gen Z students in Sri Lanka exhibit high digital health readiness and substantial reliance on AI-driven information seeking. However, institutional deployment must address privacy concerns and integrate hybrid clinical workflows to bridge the gap between high perceived utility and physical consultation preferences.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：数字健康技术，包括移动应用、远程医疗和人工智能驱动平台，正迅速重塑全球医疗服务的提供方式。尽管Z世代大学生被归类为数字原住民，但在斯里兰卡等南亚发展中国家，评估其电子健康素养、技术接受度及特定信任障碍的实证数据仍然匮乏。目的：本研究评估了斯里兰卡Z世代本科生的电子健康素养、技术接受度、在线健康信息寻求行为及采用障碍，重点关注电子健康素养、AI信任与数字医疗偏好之间的相互作用。方法：采用经过改编和验证的工具——电子健康素养量表（eHEALS）和技术接受模型（TAM），对斯里兰卡大学本科生进行横断面调查（N=172）。统计分析包括量表信度验证（Cronbach's alpha）、描述性概况分析、卡方（{chi}{superscript 2}）列联表检验、皮尔逊相关分析以及多元线性OLS回归模型。结果：参与者表现出较高的整体电子健康素养（均值=3.84 {+/-} 0.58）和对数字健康实用性的强烈认可（均值=3.99 {+/-} 0.59）。86.6%的受访者报告曾进行在线健康搜索。AI工具（如ChatGPT、Gemini）成为健康查询的第二大常用来源（57.6%），超过了YouTube（44.2%）和社交媒体（26.2%），其中医学生的AI使用率显著更高（{chi}{superscript 2}=8.70，p=0.003）。在多元回归分析中，对数字平台相对于实体诊所就诊的偏好（R{superscript 2}=0.352，p<0.001）可由感知易用性（{beta}=0.371，p=0.001）和对AI推荐的信任（{beta}=0.370，p<0.001）显著预测，而面对面咨询偏好（76.7%）和个人数据隐私风险（50.0%）仍是主要的采用障碍。结论：斯里兰卡的Z世代学生表现出较高的数字健康准备度，并严重依赖AI驱动的信息寻求。然而，机构部署必须解决隐私问题，并整合混合临床工作流程，以弥合高感知效用与实体就诊偏好之间的差距。

papers.title: Dual foundation models for accelerometry predict future health
papers.translated_title: 用于加速度计数据的双基础模型可预测未来健康状况
papers.author: Dige, M.
papers.summary: Wrist accelerometers are ubiquitous and capture activity, sleep, and cardiorespiratory motion, but how this relates to future disease across the phenome is unclear. We encoded one week of UK Biobank accelerometry from 97,696 participants using two frozen self-supervised models and trained a multilabel survival model on these embeddings with participant age and sex for 390 outcomes. In 5,253 held-out participants, mean concordance was 0.688. A single component explained 76% of predicted risk variance and was associated with future disease burden and mortality. Nevertheless, disease-specific scores added discrimination beyond this shared axis for 85 of 101 well-powered outcomes. A higher-powered full-cohort out-of-fold analysis identified prodromal neurodegenerative signatures, strongest for Parkinson's disease (five-year time-dependent AUROC 0.90; 428 cases), with limited attenuation after lead-time washout. Daytime movement contributed most, whereas sleep-related and genetic information contributed selectively. These findings establish one week of wrist movement as a scalable, low-cost representation of future health for wearable-based risk assessment.
papers.translated_summary: 腕部加速度计广泛用于捕捉活动、睡眠及心肺运动，但这些数据与未来全表型组疾病的关系尚不明确。我们利用两个冻结的自监督模型对97,696名英国生物银行参与者的单周加速度计数据进行了编码，并基于这些嵌入特征结合参与者年龄与性别训练了多标签生存模型，覆盖390种结局。在5,253名保留参与者中，平均一致性指数为0.688。单一成分解释了76%的预测风险方差，并与未来疾病负担及死亡率相关。然而，在101个统计效力充足的结局中，有85个结局的疾病特异性评分在该共享风险轴之外提供了额外判别能力。更高统计效力的全队列折外分析识别出前驱神经退行性特征，其中帕金森病最为显著（五年时间依赖性AUROC 0.90；428例），且经提前期洗脱后衰减有限。日间运动贡献最大，而睡眠相关及遗传信息则选择性贡献。这些发现确立了单周腕部运动作为可扩展、低成本未来健康表征在可穿戴风险评估中的应用价值。

papers.title: Loss-of-function of RNA-binding protein PRRC2B causes translational defects and cardiovascular malformation
papers.translated_title: RNA结合蛋白PRRC2B的功能缺失导致翻译缺陷和心血管畸形。
papers.author: Das, D.
papers.summary: Alternative splicing of pre-mRNA generates variant protein forms from a given gene, accounting for both functional redundancy and diversification. A novel RNA-binding protein, Pro-rich Coiled-coil Containing Protein 2B (PRRC2B), has been shown to mediate both upstream (u)ORF-dependent and independent regulation of translation initiation, which is essential for cell cycle progression and proliferation. We identified two alternative spliced isoforms of PRRC2B mRNA in human and mouse hearts, as well as in multiple cell types: the full-length and the exon 16-excluded isoform {triangleup}E16. A congenital heart disease-associated human mutation-mimicking knock-in of the equivalent variant in the mouse genome results in the depletion of full-length Prrc2b mRNA, but not the alternative spliced truncated form {triangleup}E16. This mouse model does not cause any apparent structural or functional cardiac disorders. In contrast, global genetic inactivation of the Prrc2b gene in the mouse genome, nullifying both mRNA isoforms, caused patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) and neonatal lethality. Bulk and single-nucleus transcriptome profiling analyses of embryonic mouse hearts at E18.5 demonstrate a significant overall downregulation of multiple smooth muscle-specific genes in Prrc2b knockout mice, likely due to a reduced smooth muscle cell number as confirmed by flow cytometry. An integrated dual-omics analysis of proteomic and translatomic changes in Prrc2b null mouse E18.5 embryonic hearts, combined with polysome-seq and RNA-seq in HEK293T cells, reveals enrichment of PRRC2B-regulated target mRNAs encoding essential factors required for cell proliferation and cardiovascular development. Lentiviral-shRNA-mediated knockdown of PRRC2B in human aorta-derived smooth muscle cells (HASMCs) reduces the proliferation, migration, and contractile function-related gene expression. Overall, this study demonstrates the functional and mechanistic connections between PRRC2B-mediated translational control and congenital cardiovascular development and disorders.
papers.translated_summary: 前体mRNA的可变剪接从特定基因产生多种蛋白质变体，既实现功能冗余也促进功能多样化。新型RNA结合蛋白PRRC2B（脯氨酸富集卷曲螺旋蛋白2B）已被证实可介导上游开放阅读框依赖性和非依赖性的翻译起始调控，这对细胞周期进程和增殖至关重要。我们在人类和小鼠心脏及多种细胞类型中鉴定出PRRC2B mRNA的两种可变剪接异构体：全长型和缺失第16号外显子的异构体ΔE16。通过模拟人类先天性心脏病相关突变，在小鼠基因组中敲入等效变异会导致全长Prrc2b mRNA缺失，但保留截短型ΔE16异构体。该小鼠模型未表现出明显的心脏结构或功能异常。相反，在小鼠基因组中全局性失活Prrc2b基因（使两种mRNA异构体均失活）会导致动脉导管未闭和新生致死。对E18.5胚胎小鼠心脏进行的批量及单核转录组分析显示，Prrc2b敲除小鼠中多个平滑肌特异性基因整体显著下调，流式细胞术证实这可能是由于平滑肌细胞数量减少所致。整合Prrc2b缺失小鼠E18.5胚胎心脏的蛋白质组与翻译组双组学分析，结合HEK293T细胞的多聚核糖体测序和RNA测序，发现PRRC2B调控的靶mRNA富集编码细胞增殖和心血管发育必需因子的序列。在人主动脉平滑肌细胞中通过慢病毒shRNA敲低PRRC2B会降低细胞增殖、迁移及收缩功能相关基因的表达。综上，本研究揭示了PRRC2B介导的翻译调控与先天性心血管发育及疾病之间的功能与机制关联。

papers.title: Design tensions in a two-sided marketplace for reusable digital therapeutics software components: a qualitative interview study
papers.translated_title: 双边市场中可复用数字治疗软件组件设计中的张力：一项定性访谈研究
papers.author: Melamed, S.
papers.summary: Objectives To identify stakeholder-perceived design tensions in a two-sided marketplace for reusable digital therapeutics (DTx) software components and to use these tensions to propose alternative marketplace concepts. Methods We conducted 24 semi-structured interviews with digital health researchers and professionals. Data were analysed using hybrid deductive-inductive codebook thematic analysis. The Magic Triangle provided the initial deductive structure. One researcher coded all transcripts; a second independently applied the developing codebook to five transcripts to refine definitions and consistency. Seventeen parent themes were synthesized into 12 design tensions, which informed three author-generated marketplace concepts. Results Participants described trade-offs concerning target users and host, component scope and customization, quality labels, verification, geographic scope, pricing, interoperability, platform launch, risks and market niche. The resulting concepts emphasized a regional startup ecosystem, a research-oriented hybrid marketplace or a global marketplace with stricter entry requirements. Discussion The concepts combine the tensions in different ways and highlight competing priorities in governance, openness, assurance, scalability and early platform growth. Conclusion Stakeholders identified recurring design choices for a DTx software-component marketplace. The concepts provide hypotheses for prototyping and evaluation; the study did not test technical feasibility, market demand, regulatory acceptability or effects on development cost or time.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 识别利益相关者在可重复使用的数字疗法（DTx）软件组件双边市场中感知的设计张力，并利用这些张力提出替代性市场概念。方法 我们对数字健康研究人员和专业人士进行了24次半结构化访谈。采用混合演绎-归纳编码本主题分析法分析数据，以“魔法三角”作为初始演绎结构。一名研究员对所有转录稿进行编码；另一名研究员独立将逐步完善的编码本应用于五份转录稿，以优化定义和一致性。17个父主题被综合为12个设计张力，并据此生成三个由作者提出的市场概念。结果 参与者描述了关于目标用户与宿主、组件范围与定制化、质量标签、验证、地理范围、定价、互操作性、平台启动、风险及市场利基的权衡。由此产生的概念强调区域性初创生态系统、研究导向的混合市场或具有更严格准入要求的全球市场。讨论 这些概念以不同方式组合了各种张力，并突出了治理、开放性、保障、可扩展性及早期平台增长中的竞争优先级。结论 利益相关者识别出DTx软件组件市场中反复出现的设计选择。这些概念为原型设计与评估提供了假设；本研究未测试技术可行性、市场需求、监管可接受性或对开发成本与时间的影响。

papers.title: Monocyte-to-Lymphocyte Ratio and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Individuals with Chronic Kidney Disease: A Systematic Review of Observational Studies
papers.translated_title: 慢性肾病患者单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值与心血管结局的关系：观察性研究的系统综述
papers.author: Messanga Bessala, R. D.
papers.summary: Aim: To evaluate the association between monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR) and cardiovascular outcomes in chronic kidney disease (CKD). Methods: We systematically searched Medline, EMBASE, Web of Science, and Scopus from inception to May 28, 2025. We included peer-reviewed observational studies assessing MLR and cardiovascular outcomes or all-cause death in CKD. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Findings were narratively synthesized and p-values pooled using Fisher's method. Statistical significance was set at p<0.05. Results: Eleven studies (n = 18,631) met our inclusion criteria. The study population ranged from non-dialysis CKD to end-stage kidney disease on dialysis, with follow-up from 1 to 24 months. Five studies (n = 16,974) examined cardiovascular death and generally reported significant associations with elevated MLR; Fisher's method indicated strong overall evidence (p<0.001). Six studies (n = 4,587) assessed cardiovascular events, yielding inconsistent findings, although some reported significant associations and identified predictive thresholds (for instance, 0.43). Five studies (n = 15,682) showed increased risk of all-cause death with increasing MLR and a predictive threshold of 0.63. Fisher's method again supported strong overall evidence (p<0.001). All except one of the eleven studies were rated as good quality. Conclusion: Elevated MLR could predict cardiovascular and all-cause death in CKD. Evidence for cardiovascular events remains inconsistent, and thresholds proposed in individual studies may not be generalizable. Large-scale, multi-ethnic, and prospective studies with standardized protocols are needed to validate MLR's role in cardiovascular risk stratification.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：评估单核细胞与淋巴细胞比值（MLR）与慢性肾脏病（CKD）患者心血管结局的关联。方法：系统检索Medline、EMBASE、Web of Science和Scopus数据库，时间从建库至2025年5月28日。纳入评估MLR与CKD患者心血管结局或全因死亡的同行评审观察性研究。两名研究者独立筛选文献、提取数据，并使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估偏倚风险。结果采用叙述性综合，P值通过Fisher法合并，统计学显著性设定为p<0.05。结果：共纳入11项研究（n=18,631）。研究人群涵盖非透析CKD至接受透析的终末期肾病，随访时间1-24个月。5项研究（n=16,974）探讨心血管死亡，普遍报告MLR升高与显著关联；Fisher法显示强总体证据（p<0.001）。6项研究（n=4,587）评估心血管事件，结果不一致，但部分研究报告显著关联并确定预测阈值（如0.43）。5项研究（n=15,682）显示MLR升高增加全因死亡风险，预测阈值为0.63。Fisher法再次支持强总体证据（p<0.001）。11项研究中除1项外均评为高质量。结论：MLR升高可预测CKD患者心血管及全因死亡。心血管事件的证据仍不一致，各研究提出的阈值可能不具普适性。需开展大规模、多民族、前瞻性标准化方案研究，以验证MLR在心血管风险分层中的作用。

papers.title: SSRI treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder as motion across a bistable fold: A calibrated circuit-plasticity model of response, remission, and augmentation
papers.translated_title: SSRI治疗强迫症作为双稳态折叠上的运动：一个校准的响应、缓解与增效的回路可塑性模型
papers.author: Sundaresan, S.
papers.summary: SSRIs are first-line for obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), yet benefit is partial, weeks-delayed, and severity-gated, and augmentation is empirical. The stable-states view is established but not drug-specific. We supply the missing coupling: a calibrated object joining serotonin pharmacokinetics, a basal-ganglia-thalamocortical circuit, and corticostriatal plasticity, in which OCD is an elevated fixed point and SSRI treatment moves this bistable state across a saddle-node fold (a tipping point). With ~35 constants fixed, two shared parameters reproduce six SSRIs (RMS 0.83 Y-BOCS points, 84 arm-timepoints) and predict a held-out trial (0.58). A fold-free model fits the means equally well, so the mean cannot separate them; they diverge only on individual-level signatures it cannot produce - a discrete, durable off-drug remission subgroup and critical slowing - with qualitative support in OCD and adjacent disorders, not yet tested as bistability signatures. These, not the mean, decide who remits and relapses; the same geometry reframes memantine and antipsychotic augmentation.
papers.translated_summary: SSRIs是强迫症的一线治疗药物，但疗效有限、起效延迟数周且受严重程度限制，联合用药仍属经验性治疗。稳态理论虽已确立但缺乏药物特异性。我们补充了缺失的耦合机制：一个校准模型整合了血清素药代动力学、基底节-丘脑-皮层回路及皮层纹状体可塑性，其中强迫症表现为升高的固定点，SSRI治疗通过鞍结分岔（临界点）改变这一双稳态状态。在固定约35个常数后，两个共享参数可复现六种SSRI的疗效（均方根误差0.83 Y-BOCS评分，84个时间点数据），并成功预测一项保留试验（误差0.58）。无分岔模型同样能拟合均值，因此均值无法区分两者；二者仅在个体层面特征上产生差异——即离散且持久的停药后缓解亚群与临界慢化现象——这些特征在强迫症及邻近疾病中已有定性支持，但尚未作为双稳态特征进行检验。决定缓解与复发的正是这些个体特征而非均值；同一几何框架可重新解释美金刚及抗精神病药物的联合用药机制。

papers.title: Personal protective beliefs and behaviors during the COVID-19 pandemic at a large, multi-campus, public university in Pennsylvania: a cross-sectional survey
papers.translated_title: 宾夕法尼亚一所大型多校区公立大学在COVID-19疫情期间的个人防护信念与行为：一项横断面调查
papers.author: Stachowski Bell, J.
papers.summary: Introduction: The COVID-19 pandemic impacted many higher education institutions. Understanding the personal protective beliefs and behaviors surrounding public health measures such as face masking, social distancing, and handwashing helps to inform public health outreach measures. Objective: This study evaluates the beliefs and occurrences of face masking, social distancing, and handwashing behaviors among people at a multi-campus, public university in Pennsylvania. Methods: From October 5-November 30, 2021, a 10-minute REDCap survey was available to students, faculty, and staff 18 years of age and older at the Pennsylvania State University (PSU). Recruitment included targeted email, social media, digital advertisements, and university newspapers. 4,231 responses were received. Simple percentage associations between the selected factors and face masking behaviors as well as beliefs on the origin of the COVID-19 virus were made with IBM SPSS Statistics, version 29.0.2.0 (20). Results: Of 3,662 completed surveys, 65.2% of respondents were positive that facemasks prevented the transmission of airborne disease, 49.9% of the respondents stated that they wore facemasks always (27.9%), almost always (26.9%), or often (11.1%). 65.3% believed social distancing prevented transmission of COVID-19, 57.5% reported social distancing while on-campus or out in public (always: 18.8%, almost always: 20.3%, often: 18.4%). The response rate for some level of conscientiously washing hands for the 20 second duration was 87.5% (always: 26.0%, almost always: 31.9%, sometimes: 19.9%, only after being out in public: 4.9%, and only when convenient: 4.8%). Conclusions: Beliefs in public health and safety measures during the COVID-19 pandemic did not always match the behaviors of individuals surveyed. Understanding barriers to performing behaviors or public health safety may help inform future areas for targeted intervention.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：COVID-19疫情对众多高等教育机构产生了影响。了解公众在佩戴口罩、保持社交距离和洗手等公共卫生措施方面的个人防护信念与行为，有助于指导公共卫生宣传工作的开展。目的：本研究评估了宾夕法尼亚州一所多校区公立大学人群在佩戴口罩、保持社交距离和洗手行为方面的信念与实践情况。方法：2021年10月5日至11月30日期间，面向宾夕法尼亚州立大学（PSU）18岁及以上的学生、教职员工开放了为期10分钟的REDCap问卷调查。招募方式包括定向邮件、社交媒体、数字广告和校报宣传，共收到4,231份回复。采用IBM SPSS Statistics 29.0.2.0（20）软件，对选定因素与佩戴口罩行为及COVID-19病毒起源信念之间的简单百分比关联进行分析。结果：在3,662份有效问卷中，65.2%的受访者确信口罩能预防空气传播疾病，49.9%的受访者表示自己"总是"（27.9%）、"几乎总是"（26.9%）或"经常"（11.1%）佩戴口罩。65.3%的人相信保持社交距离能预防COVID-19传播，57.5%的人报告在校内或公共场所保持社交距离（"总是"：18.8%，"几乎总是"：20.3%，"经常"：18.4%）。坚持洗手20秒的应答率为87.5%（"总是"：26.0%，"几乎总是"：31.9%，"有时"：19.9%，"仅在公共场所活动后"：4.9%，"仅在方便时"：4.8%）。结论：COVID-19疫情期间，受访者对公共卫生安全措施的信念与其实际行为并不完全一致。理解执行行为或公共卫生安全措施的障碍，有助于为未来针对性干预领域提供参考。

papers.title: Ensuring anatomical specificity in lesion network mapping: a multicentre study of 2,950 stroke patients
papers.translated_title: 确保病灶网络映射的解剖特异性：一项涉及2950名卒中患者的多中心研究
papers.author: Petersen, M.
papers.summary: As many neurobehavioural functions rely on distributed brain networks, anatomically diverse brain lesions can cause highly similar neurobehavioural deficits. Lesion network mapping (LNM) builds on this principle to identify symptom-specific brain networks by mapping focal lesions onto a normative functional connectome. Recent work, however, questioned the anatomical specificity of LNM, showing that commonly used LNM procedures converge on nonspecific properties of the normative connectome rather than symptom-specific networks. Here, we investigated whether anatomically specific LNM can be achieved through appropriate study design and statistical inference. Using a multicenter dataset of 2,950 stroke patients across 12 cohorts, we compared lesion-derived connectivity maps between patients with and without impairment across six cognitive domains. We evaluated group differences using both permutation of symptom labels and parametric two-sample inference, and additionally examined a one-sample approach similar to what was used in the previous critique. Both two-sample approaches yielded distinct, biologically plausible lesion network maps with evident domain-specific features, and limited correspondence to nonspecific connectome properties. Simulation analyses across 10,000 null studies confirmed valid type I error control of the permutation framework. In contrast, the one-sample analyses, which aggregated lesion connectivity maps across affected patients without a control comparison, reproduced the previously described convergence toward nonspecific connectome properties and showed marked similarity across cognitive domains. These findings demonstrate that connectome-driven convergence is not an inherent limitation of LNM, but depends critically on study design: case-control comparisons with appropriate statistical inference ensure anatomical specificity and provide a robust framework for identifying brain networks associated with distinct neurobehavioural deficits.
papers.translated_summary: 许多神经行为功能依赖于分布式脑网络，因此解剖位置不同的脑损伤可能导致高度相似的神经行为缺陷。病灶网络映射（LNM）基于这一原理，通过将局灶性损伤映射到标准功能连接组上，来识别症状特异性脑网络。然而，近期研究质疑了LNM的解剖特异性，指出常用的LNM流程会收敛于标准连接组的非特异性属性，而非症状特异性网络。本研究探讨了是否可以通过适当的研究设计和统计推断实现解剖特异性的LNM。我们利用包含12个队列、2950名卒中患者的多中心数据集，比较了六个认知领域中存在与不存在功能障碍患者的病灶衍生连接图谱。通过症状标签置换检验和参数化双样本推断评估组间差异，并额外检验了类似先前批评研究中使用的单样本方法。两种双样本方法均生成了具有明显领域特异性特征、生物学合理的病灶网络图谱，且与非特异性连接组属性的对应关系有限。基于10000次零假设研究的模拟分析证实了置换框架对I类错误的有效控制。相比之下，未设置对照比较、仅汇总受影响患者病灶连接图谱的单样本分析，重现了先前描述的向非特异性连接组属性收敛的现象，且不同认知领域间表现出显著相似性。这些发现表明，连接组驱动的收敛并非LNM的固有局限，而关键取决于研究设计：采用适当统计推断的病例-对照比较可确保解剖特异性，并为识别与不同神经行为缺陷相关的脑网络提供稳健框架。

papers.title: Participant Experience with the SpaceLabs 90227 ABPM and SOMNOmedics ABPM Pro Devices
papers.translated_title: 参与者对SpaceLabs 90227动态血压监测仪和SOMNOmedics动态血压监测Pro设备的体验
papers.author: Soddano, J.
papers.summary: Ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) is recommended for confirming hypertension and assessing out-of-office blood pressure (BP). However, patient burden and device tolerability may limit broader implementation. We compared participant experience with a traditional oscillometric ABPM device and a compact cuff-integrated ABPM. The PRO-BP Study was a pilot randomized crossover study of 20 adults in New York City. Participants completed two 24-hour ABPM periods over 7 days using the SpaceLabs 90227 and SOMNOmedics ABPM Pro devices. After each period, participants rated comfort, pain, sleep interference, embarrassment, noise, skin irritation, and interference with daytime activities. Both devices achieved guideline-based recording-quality thresholds. Compared with SpaceLabs, ABPM Pro was associated with greater comfort (median 7.0 [IQR, 5.0-8.5] vs 3.5 [IQR, 2.0-6.5]; P=0.004), less pain (1.5 [0-3.5] vs 5.0 [0.5-7.0]; P=0.003), and less embarrassment (0.5 [0-3.5] vs 3.0 [0-6.0]; P=0.01). Other experience ratings did not differ significantly. Participant experience should be considered alongside recording quality when evaluating validated ambulatory BP monitoring technologies.
papers.translated_summary: 动态血压监测（ABPM）被推荐用于确诊高血压及评估诊室外血压（BP），但患者负担和设备耐受性可能限制其广泛应用。我们比较了传统示波法ABPM设备与紧凑型袖带集成式ABPM设备的受试者体验。PRO-BP研究是一项在纽约市20名成人中开展的试点随机交叉研究。受试者在7天内使用SpaceLabs 90227和SOMNOmedics ABPM Pro设备完成两次24小时动态血压监测。每次监测后，受试者对舒适度、疼痛感、睡眠干扰、尴尬程度、噪音、皮肤刺激及日间活动干扰进行评分。两种设备均达到指南要求的记录质量阈值。与SpaceLabs相比，ABPM Pro的舒适度更高（中位数7.0 [IQR, 5.0-8.5] vs 3.5 [IQR, 2.0-6.5]；P=0.004），疼痛感更轻（1.5 [0-3.5] vs 5.0 [0.5-7.0]；P=0.003），尴尬程度更低（0.5 [0-3.5] vs 3.0 [0-6.0]；P=0.01）。其他体验评分无显著差异。在评估经验证的动态血压监测技术时，应同时考虑受试者体验与记录质量。

papers.title: Prevalence, determinants, and cardiometabolic consequences of overweight and obesity among people with Down syndrome: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.translated_title: 唐氏综合征患者超重和肥胖的患病率、决定因素及心脏代谢后果：一项系统综述与荟萃分析。
papers.author: Nambooze, R.
papers.summary: Objective. This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesised the global prevalence of overweight and obesity in people with Down syndrome (DS) across the lifespan, characterised determinants of excess adiposity, and examined associations with adverse cardiometabolic outcomes. Methods. Six databases were searched without date or language restriction. Two independent reviewers screened studies, extracted data, and assessed quality using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Checklist for Prevalence Studies. Prevalence was pooled using a random-effects logit model. A pre-specified subgroup analysis by age band was conducted. Publication bias was assessed with Egger's test and certainty of evidence with Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE). Results. Twenty-six studies (7,840 individuals; 14 countries) were included. The pooled prevalence was 18% (95% CI 15-22%) in children and adolescents, 36% (95% CI 26-47%) in adults, and 30% (95% CI 20-43%) in mixed-age cohorts; the test for subgroup differences was significant. The overall pooled prevalence was 22% (95% CI 18-26%; prediction interval 7-53%; I^2 = 95.3%). No publication bias was detected (Egger's t = 0.39, p = 0.6964). DS-specific growth charts yielded estimates 14-37 percentage points lower than general-population references applied to the same cohorts. Obesity more than doubled obstructive sleep apnea risk (RR 2.4; 95% CI 1.34-4.34) and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease was present in 82% of obese versus 45% of non-obese children with DS. GRADE certainty was Moderate for prevalence estimates. Conclusions. Overweight and obesity in DS are highly prevalent, age-progressive, and substantially exceed general-population rates at every life stage. Roughly one in five people with DS is affected overall, rising to more than one in three adults. The reference chart applied is the single largest source of heterogeneity in reported estimates. Cardiometabolic surveillance, adapted lifestyle interventions, and primary prevalence research from low- and middle-income countries are the highest-priority gaps.
papers.translated_summary: 目的。本系统综述与荟萃分析综合了唐氏综合征（DS）患者全生命周期的超重与肥胖全球患病率，描述了脂肪过多的决定因素，并探讨了其与不良心血管代谢结局的关联。方法。检索六个数据库，无日期或语言限制。两名独立评审员筛选研究、提取数据，并使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所患病率研究关键评估清单评估质量。采用随机效应logit模型合并患病率。按年龄分组进行预设亚组分析。通过Egger检验评估发表偏倚，使用推荐评估、发展与评价分级（GRADE）评估证据确定性。结果。纳入26项研究（7,840名个体；14个国家）。儿童青少年合并患病率为18%（95% CI 15-22%），成人为36%（95% CI 26-47%），混合年龄队列为30%（95% CI 20-43%）；亚组差异检验显著。总体合并患病率为22%（95% CI 18-26%；预测区间7-53%；I²=95.3%）。未检测到发表偏倚（Egger t=0.39，p=0.6964）。DS特异性生长图表得出的估计值比同一队列应用一般人群参考值低14-37个百分点。肥胖使阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停风险增加超过两倍（RR 2.4；95% CI 1.34-4.34），非酒精性脂肪肝病在DS肥胖儿童中占82%，而非肥胖儿童中为45%。GRADE对患病率估计的确定性为中等。结论。DS患者超重与肥胖高度流行、随年龄增长而加重，并在每个生命阶段显著超过一般人群水平。总体约五分之一的DS患者受影响，成人中超过三分之一。所应用的参考图表是报告估计值异质性的最大单一来源。心血管代谢监测、适应性生活方式干预以及来自低收入和中等国家的患病率基础研究是最高优先级的空白领域。
